source: Lane numbering is not the rule. If the lanes access the same 32 values in a different order, the set of required segments can remain unchanged. Coalescing is therefore about the address footprint created by the warp, not about forcing laneZXMATH0000XZ to read elementZXMATH0001XZ
zh: 车道编号不是规则。如果通道以不同的顺序访问相同的 32 个值，则所需段的集合可以保持不变。因此，合并与扭曲创建的地址占用有关，而不是强制 LaneZXMATH0000XZ 读取 elementZXMATH0001XZ
